Hero.tagline: International Rap Artist based in Switzerland

Bio.title: Biography
Bio.content: Thugwangel brings a unique sound from the heart of Switzerland to the world. Rapping in English, his international style blends deep beats with lyrical prowess.
Bio.extra: Born in the mountains, raised on the beats. Thugwangel represents the new wave of Swiss hip-hop, breaking barriers with English lyrics that resonate globally.
